bagPolicy.summary: Only clear bags no larger than 12" x 12" x 6" are permitted at Rocket Arena. All bags are subject to inspection upon entry.
allowed: clear bags no larger than 12" x 12" x 6"
prohibited: Tobacco Products including Vapes and E-Cigarettes
Coolers, Cans or Bottles (plastic or glass)
Selfie sticks, Go Pros, Tripods, Video/Audio Recorders, Drones
Noise making devices, Airhorns, Fireworks, Inflatable Objects, Laser Pointers
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions can be made for guests with food allergies along with diaper bags and bags for medical purposes.

parking.note: Garage parking is available across 8th Street and 3rd Avenue from the arena, with additional parking at Pullman Square a block further east. Street parking may also be available.

rideshare.note: Use the designated rideshare pickup and drop-off locations at Huron East and 8th Street, West Huron at Tower City, Ontario Street, Prospect Avenue East and 4th Street, or West Prospect at Tower City.

concessions.note: Marshall Health Network Arena offers a variety of food and drink options including large Cokes, popcorn, Miller Lite, and hot dogs. Gluten-free options are available, and all concessions are cashless, accepting major credit/debit cards and mobile payments.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Rocket Arena event information and accessible seating and service information is available on the Accessibility Seating page.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Rocket Arena has a no re-entry policy: once you leave the building after entering, you cannot re-enter, including to smoke or vape. Please Note: Rocket Arena has a no re-entry policy; once you leave the building during an event, you will not be permitted to return.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Rocket Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Door times for all Cleveland Monsters games will be 60 minutes prior to the puck dropping with Atrium doors opening 90 minutes before the game. Door times for Cavaliers games Monday through Thursday are 75 minutes prior to tipoff with Atrium doors opening 90 minutes before the game.
